description.value: Tera V Burger is an all-vegan fast-casual restaurant on West Broadway in Vancouver, specializing in plant-based burgers, loaded bowls, fries, and shakes — with every menu item fully vegan rather than just vegan-optional. It offers dine-in with reservations, takeaway, and home delivery, making it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through the Kitsilano–Point Grey corridor. Reviewers consistently praise the bold flavors and welcoming atmosphere, noting the food impresses even committed meat-eaters.
